"""Runs ON the Hopsworks cluster as a Python job: point-in-time batch scoring."""

import json
import math

import pandas as pd

import hopsworks

T = 1773565200000

project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()
dataset_api = project.get_dataset_api()

hist_path = dataset_api.download("Resources/feature_history_4fa858.csv", overwrite=True)
model_path = dataset_api.download("Resources/model_4fa858.json", overwrite=True)

df = pd.read_csv(hist_path)
with open(model_path) as f:
    model = json.load(f)
w = model["weights"]
bias = model["bias"]

print("total rows:", len(df), "accounts:", df["account_id"].nunique())

valid = df[df["event_time"] <= T]
print("rows at/before T:", len(valid), "accounts at/before T:", valid["account_id"].nunique())

latest = (
    valid.sort_values(["account_id", "event_time"])
    .groupby("account_id", as_index=False)
    .tail(1)
)

z = w["f1"] * latest["f1"] + w["f2"] * latest["f2"] + w["f3"] * latest["f3"] + bias
scores = [round(1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-v)), 6) for v in z]

out = pd.DataFrame(
    {"account_id": latest["account_id"].astype(str).values, "score": scores}
).sort_values("account_id").reset_index(drop=True)
print(out.head(10))
print("output rows:", len(out))

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="scores4fa858",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["account_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
    description="Batch scores as of T=1773565200000 (point-in-time correct)",
)

"""Runs ON the Hopsworks cluster as a Python job: point-in-time batch scoring."""

import json
import math

import pandas as pd

import hopsworks

T = 1773565200000

project = hopsworks.login()
fs = project.get_feature_store()
dataset_api = project.get_dataset_api()

hist_path = dataset_api.download("Resources/feature_history_4fa858.csv", overwrite=True)
model_path = dataset_api.download("Resources/model_4fa858.json", overwrite=True)

df = pd.read_csv(hist_path)
with open(model_path) as f:
    model = json.load(f)
w = model["weights"]
bias = model["bias"]

print("total rows:", len(df), "accounts:", df["account_id"].nunique())

valid = df[df["event_time"] <= T]
print("rows at/before T:", len(valid), "accounts at/before T:", valid["account_id"].nunique())

latest = (
    valid.sort_values(["account_id", "event_time"])
    .groupby("account_id", as_index=False)
    .tail(1)
)

z = w["f1"] * latest["f1"] + w["f2"] * latest["f2"] + w["f3"] * latest["f3"] + bias
scores = [round(1.0 / (1.0 + math.exp(-v)), 6) for v in z]

out = pd.DataFrame(
    {"account_id": latest["account_id"].astype(str).values, "score": scores}
).sort_values("account_id").reset_index(drop=True)
print(out.head(10))
print("output rows:", len(out))

fg = fs.get_or_create_feature_group(
    name="scores4fa858",
    version=1,
    primary_key=["account_id"],
    online_enabled=True,
    description="Batch scores as of T=1773565200000 (point-in-time correct)",
)
fg.insert(out, wait=True)
print("INSERT DONE:", len(out), "rows into scores4fa858 v1 (online_enabled=True)")

readback = fg.read()
print("offline readback rows:", len(readback))
print(readback.sort_values("account_id").head(5))

**How it was computed (all on the platform):** The local Python engine couldn't write to the feature store from this sandbox (direct HopsFS/Kafka connections are blocked; only the HTTPS proxy works — I also had to clear `NO_PROXY`, which was routing the platform's 10.x address around the proxy). So I ran the work as a Hopsworks **Python job on the cluster**: uploaded a scoring script via the Dataset API and executed it platform-side. The job filtered the 570 feature-history revisions to those with `event_time ≤ T = 1773565200000` (414 rows, still covering all 80 accounts), took the most recent revision per account, applied `score = sigmoid(-0.1306·f1 + 0.0121·f2 − 0.7418·f3 − 0.8397)` rounded to 6 decimals, and inserted the result into the online-enabled feature group. Spot check: A0000 correctly uses its 2026-03-08 revision (two later revisions after T are excluded) giving 0.243892.

One environment quirk worth noting: job containers don't mount the project's `Resources` dataset (uploaded data files weren't visible at `/hopsfs/Resources` inside the job, only the app script is copied there), so the 24 KB input CSV was embedded in the job script itself. The final external online-read attempt failed only because the sandbox blocks direct MySQL connections from this machine — the platform-side ingestion and reads all succeeded.
